nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of each account.
Public string holding the token name 'PolyusCdsTok20220328II'.
Public string holding the token symbol 'POLYTOKII'.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 18.
Public uint256 total supply minted to the deployer at construction.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of approved spend allowances.
Constructor-like public function that assigns the entire totalSupply to msg.sender.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) that moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to'.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) that sets allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) that spends an allowance and moves tokens.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender.
Raw unchecked subtraction from the sender balance in transfer().
Raw unchecked addition to the recipient balance in transfer().
Raw unchecked subtraction from the 'from' balance in transferFrom().
Raw unchecked subtraction of the spent amount from the nested allowance mapping.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Spender address parameter of approve().
Allowance amount parameter of approve().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().
Named boolean return variable of transfer().
Named boolean return variable of approve().
Named boolean return variable of transferFrom().

edges.reason: The constructor writes the initial balanceOf entry for the deployer.
msg.sender determines which account receives the totalSupply in the constructor.
totalSupply is assigned into balanceOf[msg.sender] at construction.
transfer() executes the unchecked balance subtraction.
transfer() executes the unchecked balance addition.
msg.sender indexes the balance that is decremented without SafeMath.
The amount parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
The recipient parameter selects the balance mapping slot that is credited.
The amount parameter is added to balanceOf[to] without overflow protection.
Caller-controlled sender participates in the transfer state update.
transfer() writes and returns the named boolean result.
approve() writes the allowance state variable.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance mapping entry.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
The value parameter is stored as the approved allowance amount.
approve() writes and returns the named boolean result.
transferFrom() executes the unchecked subtraction from balanceOf[from].
transferFrom() executes the unchecked addition to balanceOf[to].
transferFrom() executes the unchecked subtraction from the nested allowance.
The from parameter indexes the balance that is decremented without SafeMath.
The value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[from] without underflow protection.
The to parameter selects the balance slot credited during transferFrom().
The value parameter is added to balanceOf[to] without overflow protection.
msg.sender is the spender key used to locate and reduce the allowance entry.
The from parameter is the owner key of the allowance entry that is reduced.
The value parameter is subtracted from allowance[from][msg.sender] unchecked.
The from parameter indexes the allowance mapping that is read and written.
transferFrom() mutates the balanceOf state variable for both source and destination.
transferFrom() writes and returns the named boolean result.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to select the credited balance slot in transfer().
The amount parameter flows directly into the unchecked sender balance subtraction.
The spender parameter is consumed only by the approve() allowance write.
The value parameter is consumed only as the stored allowance amount in approve().
The from parameter directly indexes the balance decremented in transferFrom().
The to parameter directly indexes the balance credited in transferFrom().
The value parameter is the subtracted amount in the transferFrom() balance update.
The named return variable is internal to transfer() and carries no independent semantics.
The named return variable is internal to approve() and carries no independent semantics.
The named return variable is internal to transferFrom() and carries no independent semantics.
